theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ (Y : Set (Eucl N)), Bornology.IsBounded Y → ∀ A : ℝ, {β : LatticeFaceIndex n N → ℝ | (∀ F, ∃ k : ℤ, β F = k) ∧ ∀ F, β F ≠ 0 → latticeFace ρ F ⊆ Y ∧ |β F| ≤ A}.Finite
